basic_details.organization_name: Women and Child Development Department Odisha
basic_details.short_information: Women and Child Development Department Odisha (WCD Odisha) Anganwadi Helper Notification 2026 has been released on 18 July 2026 on the official website wcd.odisha.gov.in. A total of 3 vacancies have been announced through the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Helper Recruitment 2026.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Helper Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 03-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of WCD Odisha to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: WCD Odisha Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download WCD Odisha Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Helper Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 03-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of WCD Odisha to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Helper Posts Recruitment 2026 is 03 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for Anganwadi Helper posts under ICDS in the Women and Child Development Department Odisha for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to visit the official website or use the provided link to submit their application form.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates applying for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Helper Posts Recruitment 2026. Both General/OBC and SC/ST candidates are exempt from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Helper Posts Recruitment 2026 primarily involves Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on the verification of their submitted documents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for the recruited candidates?
faq.answer: The posts announced under this recruitment are on a contractual basis. Candidates selected will be appointed on a contract for a specified period as per the department's terms.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page. It is highly recommended to download and read the notification thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q8. What are the different posts available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The available posts include Sahayak, Sahayika, Cook, and Sweeper. Each of these posts has a specific number of vacancies allocated.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for WCD Odisha?
faq.answer: The official website for the Women and Child Development Department Odisha is www.engagement-awc.odisha.gov.in. All relevant information and application procedures will be available here.

faq.question: Q10. Are there any age relaxations provided?
faq.answer: Information regarding age limits and any applicable relaxations for reserved categories is not explicitly detailed here and should be confirmed by referring to the official notification PDF.
